name: Fried sticky-rice cakes
summary: Fried cakes with a sticky-rice shell. The rectangle has no filling. The round one holds minced pork, wood-ear, and glass noodles. A 2021 piece was 5,000 VND. The price now is Check on arrival.
origin: VnExpress on 27 Mar 2021 names bánh nếp chiên among the cheap snacks in Buon Ma Thuot.
howToEat: The article says one stall row on Phùng Chí Kiên sells only this cake. The shell is sticky rice, like xôi. Pieces are fried crisp and cut small. Add salty-sweet soy or chili sauce. It prints 5,000 VND a cake. The price now is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.
where: Phùng Chí Kiên. A stall number is Check on arrival.
